comment: Add Focusgroup V2 feed and itemcontrols support, including owner-relative activity and memory for nested controls and grid cells. Like feed and grid, the V2 itemcontrols and noitemcontrols modifiers are polyfilled even when the browser reports native support, unless __FOCUSGROUP_POLYFILL_ALLOW_NATIVE_V2__ is set. Behavior changes for custom FocusGroup item collections: disconnect() now restores item and owner decorations, decorateOwner is called with null when undecorating and receives the collection's validity after every rebuild, and flush() must retain pending author mutations instead of discarding them (implementations that call takeRecords() and drop the records must be updated).
